scientific_integrity.computational_evidence: Exact-rational finite enumeration over 100136 profiles across 10 checks
scientific_integrity.limitations: Finite computations are checks, not proofs of asymptotic conclusions.
scientific_integrity.proof_status: Analytic path-exposure argument for all admissible sizes and scales

scientific_limitations: Only uniform independent delegations on a complete directed graph without loops are covered.
At the critical scale, only the first two limiting moments and non-concentration are established, not a full weak limit law.
Voting accuracy, alternative cycle handling, correlated delegation and strategic choice are not covered.
Finite partition probabilities for the complete-graph model were previously available; the novelty claim concerns a singular-scale variance law.
Equivalent results in older random-mapping theory remain a bibliographic risk.
title: Critical delegation produces non-self-averaging lost voting weight
